scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract MSB3277 assembly version conflict details
scenarios.reasoning: The agent efficiently analyzed the binlog and correctly identified most key details: the error code (MSB3277), the conflicting assembly (System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource), the affected project (DeviceConfigClient), and the target framework (net8.0). The only missing detail was the specific conflicting versions (10.0.0.0 vs 10.0.0.3). The approach was methodical with no errors, completing in just 3 turns.
